notes: Customer quotations (ST_PROPOSAL_MAST, types EFFECT 7 / TRNS_TYPE 16): legacy numbering (serial per type, DATE_SERIAL per date), expiry, customer/salesman/date checks, 4-step approval workflow with permissions and credit check, read-only states, line policy prices/lots/choice flags, VAT (APP_RULES_SA); actions TO_ORDER / TO_PROPOSAL / TO_TRQ / TO_TRANSFER (APP_CONV) and CHOICE_ALL / UNAV_ALL / LOAD_EXCEL (APP_ACT_ST), soft delete (KEY-DELREC), credit / totals / counters displays

ST_PROPOSAL_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_PROPOSAL_DET.LOT_NUMBER.sql: (select max(c.lot_number) from st_item_confg c where c.item_confg_id = t.item_confg_id)

ST_PROPOSAL_MAST.CLASS_CODE.lov: select c.class_code || ' - ' || c.desc_a d, c.class_code r from ar_st_item_classes c order by c.class_code

ST_PROPOSAL_MAST.PAYMENT_TYPE.lov: select p.serial || ' - ' || p.type_name d, p.serial r from st_payment_terms p order by p.serial

ST_PROPOSAL_DET.ITEM_CONFG_ID.lov: select c.item_confg_id || ' - ' || c.lot_number || ' - ' || to_char(c.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, c.item_confg_id r from st_item_confg c where c.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE order by c.expire_date, c.item_confg_id

rules.where: NVL(DELETE_FLAG,0) = 0 AND TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 7 AND T.TRNS_TYPE = 16) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE TP.FLAG = 1 AND TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR SALESMAN_CODE IS NULL OR SALESMAN_CODE IN (SELECT SALESMAN_CODE FROM AR_SALESMAN_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR CUSTOMER_CODE IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_CODE IN (SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE FROM AR_CUST_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR NVL((SELECT U.OWNER_SALES_ORDER_ONLY FROM USERS U WHERE U.USERS_CODE = :G_USER_CODE),0) <> 1 OR INSERT_USER = :G_USER_CODE)

actions.name: TO_ORDER
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد تحويل عرض السعر إلى أمر بيع؟ سيتم إنشاء أمر بيع معتمد بالأصناف المختارة والمتاحة موزعة على الشحنات حسب تاريخ الصلاحية.
actions.confirm_e: Convert this quotation to a sales order? An approved sales order is created with the chosen, available items, split over the lots by expiry date.
actions.success_a: تم عمل أمر البيع من عرض السعر
actions.success_e: The sales order was created from the quotation

actions.name: TO_PROPOSAL
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد تحويل الأصناف غير المتاحة إلى عرض سعر لمخزن آخر؟
actions.confirm_e: Move the unavailable items to a quotation of another store?

params.name: PROPOSAL_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', t.desc_e, t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where t.effect = 7 and nvl(t.trns_type, 0) = 16 and nvl(t.join_type, 0) in (3, 4) and t.trns_type_code <> :PAGE_TRNS_TYPE_CODE and t.store_code <> :PAGE_STORE_CODE and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

params.name: PROPOSAL_STORE
params.label_a: مخزن عرض السعر (إذا لم يكن لنوع الحركة مخزن)
params.label_e: Proposal Price Store (when the type has none)
params.lov_sql: select s.store_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', s.name_e, s.name_a) d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or s.store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

params.name: PROPOSAL_DATE
params.default: select to_char(trns_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') from st_proposal_mast where rowid = chartorowid(:PAGE_ROWID)

actions.name: TO_TRQ
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد عمل طلب تحويل بالأصناف غير المتاحة من مخزن آخر؟
actions.confirm_e: Request the unavailable items from another store?

params.name: TRQ_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', t.desc_e, t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where t.effect = 7 and nvl(t.trns_type, 0) = 9 and t.trns_type_code <> :PAGE_TRNS_TYPE_CODE and t.store_code <> :PAGE_STORE_CODE and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

params.name: TRQ_STORE
params.label_a: مخزن طلب التحويل (إذا لم يكن لنوع الحركة مخزن)
params.label_e: Transfer Store (when the type has none)
params.lov_sql: select s.store_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', s.name_e, s.name_a) d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or s.store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

params.name: TRQ_DATE
params.default: select to_char(trns_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') from st_proposal_mast where rowid = chartorowid(:PAGE_ROWID)

actions.name: TO_TRANSFER
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد عمل حركة تحويل (صادر ووارد) بالأصناف المختارة من مخزن عرض السعر إلى المخزن المحدد؟
actions.confirm_e: Issue the chosen items to the given store (issue and receipt transfers)?

params.name: FROM_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', t.desc_e, t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where nvl(t.effect, 0) = 5 and nvl(t.trns_type, 0) = 9 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

params.name: TO_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', t.desc_e, t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where nvl(t.effect, 0) = 6 and nvl(t.trns_type, 0) = 9 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

params.name: TO_STORE
params.lov_sql: select s.store_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', s.name_e, s.name_a) d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or s.store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

actions.name: CHOICE_ALL
actions.confirm_e: Update the choice of the items?

params.name: CHOICE_MODE
params.lov_sql: select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Choose all available items', 'اختيار كل الأصناف المتاحة') d, 1 r from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Clear the choice', 'إلغاء اختيار الأصناف') d, 0 r from dual

actions.name: UNAV_ALL
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد تحديث علامة غير متاح للأصناف؟
actions.confirm_e: Update the unavailable flag of the items?

params.name: UNAV_MODE
params.lov_sql: select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Mark the items not chosen unavailable', 'الأصناف غير المختارة غير متاحة') d, 1 r from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Clear the unavailable flag', 'إلغاء علامة غير متاح') d, 0 r from dual

actions.name: LOAD_EXCEL
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد تحميل أصناف عرض السعر من الملف؟ الورقة الأولى، من السطر الثاني حتى أول صنف فارغ، بالأعمدة: المجموعة، الصنف، الوحدة، السعر، رقم الشحنة، رقم التشغيلة، تاريخ الصلاحية (يوم/شهر/سنة)، الكمية، خصم 1، خصم 2، خصم 3 (كنسب عشرية)، البونص، البونص الإضافي.
actions.confirm_e: Load the quotation items from the file? First sheet, from row 2 to the first empty item, columns: group, item, unit, price, lot id, lot number, expiry (DD/MM/YYYY), quantity, discount 1, 2, 3 (as fractions), bonus, extra bonus.
